description: A custom constraint, applied when the model solves. For one scenario only, create it with is_active false, then edit_constraint active true in that scenario. DSL (recommended, constraint_language='dsl'): `SUM(Generator.p WHERE carrier = "coal") <= 0.3 * DEMAND()`, `SUM(Generator.p_nom_opt WHERE carrier = "solar") >= 500`, `TOTAL(Generator.p WHERE carrier = "gas") <= 1000000` (MWh); SUM, TOTAL, COUNT, DEMAND(), EMISSIONS(), WHERE carrier/bus, FOR EACH PERIOD/BUS/DAY/WEEK/MONTH, >= <= ==. Python (constraint_language='python'): code on the network `n` (its optimisation model is `n.model`), with `pd`, `np`. The code is checked first; check_only: true only checks it. Or, instead of code, template {kind: build_rate|capacity_cap|land_limit|renewable_share|emissions_cap|reserve_margin, carriers, bus, mw_per_year, max_mw, area_km2, km2_per_mw, share, tonnes, margin}: written for you, and checked against fixed capacity.

constraint_code.description: The constraint code in DSL or Python

is_active.description: Whether the constraint is active (default true)

name.description: Name of the constraint (e.g. 'Min Wind Generation', 'CO2 Cap')

name: create_constraint
